finalText:
It's building clean now, no errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bump changing how config gets passed in:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That was crashing the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw an error whenever a flag was left unset (`undefined`), because the old config loader used to send `false` there instead. Now it just treats "unset" as "off," same as before.

The rest of the wall of text was just deprecation warnings from the bump (`Buffer()`, punycode, sync loader hooks, and so on) — safe to ignore for now. Build finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
